module_role: Formal-point-matrix status and ownership ledger. M-201 supplies typed schematic templates, not a row-based BAS points list, so this intentionally has no fabricated formal-matrix rows or installed terminal total.
source_points_composite: controls_context_m201 records the three visual schematic templates and their typed-bubble context. It has no formal source matrix tables because none are printed in the supplied set.
ownership_binding_semantics: No row-level physical owner, controller, wiring or transport is stated. The three controls templates identify diagram scope only.
expanded_count_warning: There are zero formal points-matrix rows in the supplied set. Typed bubbles on M-201 are retained as schematic context, but are not converted into a terminal count or multiplied by schedule equipment.

installed_IO_total.reason: No typed formal points matrix, controller schedule, panel terminal list, network point export, or equipment-instance multiplier is supplied.

point_transport.note: M-201 directs connection to the existing DDC system, but does not assign transport or wiring method to individual schematic bubbles.
